legend.policy: append the pre-normalization weighted yield to every displayed MC process and the raw event count to Data

normalization.data: one common factor over every bin and block in each plot
normalization.mc: one common factor over every process, bin, and block in each plot
normalization.ntop_split_policy: one common data factor and one common MC factor across both Nt blocks
normalization.ratio: normalized data divided by normalized total MC

uncertainty_model.combination: MC statistical and shape-systematic components added in quadrature
uncertainty_model.data: Poisson statistical uncertainty divided by the raw data integral
uncertainty_model.mc_shape_systematics: each stored Up and Down total background shape independently normalized to unit area before the maximum envelope is evaluated
uncertainty_model.mc_stat: raw MC statistical uncertainty divided by the raw MC integral
